name: Hollow Laurel Butcher
loreTies: A brutal parody of Olympian excellence that treats victory as proof even when the contest is corrupted.
Challenges highest-attack Deity and gains pressure if ignored.
Erasure is not death; erasure is ownership without memory.
shortBackstory: Hollow Laurel Butcher is a Hollow threat creature built for campaign and event encounters, turning erased memory into major battlefield pressure.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Hollow Laurel Butcher formed where the Hollow learned a specific weakness in remembered civilization. It is not a Deity, not a citizen, and not a recruitable unit; it is a symptom of the Gate giving absence a body.

chapters.title: Hollow Function
chapters.text: Its role inside the Hollow threat faction is precise: Challenges highest-attack Deity and gains pressure if ignored. This lets mission designers select it by encounter tags instead of treating Hollow enemies as one shapeless swarm.

chapters.title: Lore Tie
chapters.text: A brutal parody of Olympian excellence that treats victory as proof even when the contest is corrupted.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: Hollow Laurel Butcher can appear in Normal missions, Elite remixes, Hollow Breach events, Ascension floors, and raid add waves when its tags match the objective pressure. It must always reinforce Hollowing: isolation, corrupted memory, broken objectives, or stolen meaning.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Art and gameplay must keep Hollow Laurel Butcher visibly non-playable. Its silhouette uses muscular faceless gladiator silhouette, black marble skin, broken bronze laurel fused to skull, ichorless cracks. while its abilities — Dirty Triumph, Contest Ruin, Laurel Cleave — create battlefield pressure without confusing it for a faction Deity.

developmentStatus: Readable Hollow creature profile integrated into campaign/event threat pages.
